MARKET_PLAYER_DIST is reconstructed FROM the Kalshi ladder and the HYBRID arms blend the two: they are reported, flagged `market_derived`, and never promoted into the primary slot. Being primary says nothing about authority: every arm answer carries its production-eligibility status, and on the current evidence the MARKET is the better player-prop distribution.
